text:
anya: Quick sync 1h: planning a small security drill Wed 10:00 PT. Scope: base image patch + KMS key rotation 2-stage validation + RBAC change + runtime cosign/SBOM verification. Need owners and a canary.
kate: I can coordinate the canary build and SBOM publish. Do we want signed SBOMs only or attestations too?
mike: Signed SBOMs should be enough for this run. We'll also publish a simple in-toto attestation JSON to the artifact metadata so runtime can fetch one object.
jen: For RBAC, prefer creating a time-limited rolebinding instead of changing existing roles. Example: `kubectl apply -f drill-rolebinding.yaml` with TTL via our infra tool.
anya: Yes TTL bindings are better. Ops: can you reserve a 20m maintenance window and mark read-only prod probes?
ops-oncall: Reserved Wed 10:00-10:20 PT. Marking as maintenance and will mute noisy alerts. Probes to prod will be audit-only (no writes).
sec-bot: [auto] Latest vuln scan: baseimage ubuntu-22.04  medium (openssl) found 6h ago. Patch recommended before pushing to prod.
kate: We'll build a patched canary image for the drill. If vuln patching blocks, we abort.
mike: For KMS rotation test: plan is to create a new key version, update the cosign signer to use it, publish signed digest, then rotate back. Need to confirm runtime can fetch public key / key metadata from KMS.
anya: Confirmed runtime has network egress to KMS meta endpoints. But need to ensure KMS permissions for runtime identity to read public keys. I'll snapshot IAM and prepare a minimal policy.
jen: Who will run the runtime smoke test? We should have a short script: pull image -> run `cosign verify` -> check SBOM hash -> small container start smoke. If verify fails, do feature-flag toggle to skip verification.
mike: I'll own smoke script and the feature-flag rollback. Script will emit JSON status to `#incidents` and upload logs to the evidence bucket.
ops-oncall: Add a rollback plan: 1) disable image verification flag; 2) revert KMS key version; 3) redeploy runtime. Documented and tested?
anya: I'll draft rollback steps and post to runbook. Also collecting KMS audit logs (Cloud Audit Log) and artifact registry logs during drill.
kate: CI job names: `canary-build-sbom` will publish SBOM and cosign-signed digest. I'll add a metadata tag `drill=true` to artifacts.
sec-bot: [auto] Note: ensure cosign-resolver uses `kms://` uri to avoid public key rotation mismatch.
jen: For RBAC change: sample YAML we'll apply then bind TTL for 2 hours. After drill we revoke.
jen: YAML snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: drill-imagepull
  namespace: inference-staging
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: drill-runner
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: view
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
ops-oncall: Reminder: ensure service account tokens are audited and deleted after. We'll enable delete hook in infra.
mike: Timeline: Mon EOD - artifacts ready, Tue morning - IAM snapshot + runbook posted, Wed 10:00 - drill, Wed 12:00 - evidence bundle.
kate: I'll push a test artifact now to staging with `drill=true`. If anyone needs access to the artifact: `gcr.io/redwood-staging/canary:drill-2026-03-21`.
anya: Perfect. After drill, please post the evidence list: SBOM blob path, cosign verify output, KMS log export path, RBAC diffs, runtime logs. We'll attach to compliance ticket.
sec-bot: [auto] Scan note: please re-run vulnerability scan after baseimage patch and before canary deploy.
jen: Acknowledged. If we hit any unexpected verification failures, page `#eng-oncall` and we'll run rollback.
ops-oncall: I'll page and document any incidents. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
